meta.title: Increase Event Time: Enter extremely large custom time (e.g., 31 December 2099) updates end time
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ event without creating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the case's withdrawal visibility configuration.
Keep live-event withdrawal available according to the required configuration.
Open the RFQ stage of the prepared event.
Reach the Responses tab specified by the scenario.
Open the RFQ's Increase Event Time window.

args.goal: In the Increase Event Time window, select Custom Fixed time, enter 31 December 2099 11:59 PM in the custom date-time field, click Ok, and stop on the RFQ page showing the event end time as 31 December 2099 11:59 PM.

steps.note: Perform and visually verify the absolute custom end-time update, which the parameterized extension step cannot express.
Assert the required confirmation toast appeared.
